summary: C2: CURATED_MODELS map + slug resolver in lib/model.ts
description:
Slug → OpenRouter ID indirection (BRD §5.1). Server-side only;
no UI yet. The map is the source of truth for which model each
provider slug points at; bumping it is how we silently roll
forward across version releases.

Files:
  - src/lib/model.ts — add CURATED_MODELS const + CuratedSlug
    type + resolveCuratedModel(slug) helper. Existing MODELS
    const stays for backwards compat during phase 1; new code
    references CURATED_MODELS only.
  - src/__tests__/model.test.ts (new) — exhaustive slug coverage.

Map at landing time:
    deepseek  → deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
    xai       → x-ai/grok-4.3
    anthropic → anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6
    openai    → openai/gpt-5.4

Done when:
  - CURATED_MODELS keys are exactly: deepseek, xai, anthropic, openai.
  - resolveCuratedModel('anthropic') === 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6'.
  - Unknown-slug calls are TypeScript compile errors.
  - npx vitest run src/__tests__/model.test.ts clean.

Tests: vitest unit only — small constant + small resolver.

Operator action post-merge: none.

Depends on: nothing. Can land before or after C1.
